# Vevaar — Gautam (iamvevaar)

> Creative Software Engineer and Full Stack Engineer at AstroSure, based in
> Chennai, India. Designer and frontend developer hybrid who is comfortable
> across the backend. Builds in public, ships side products, and writes
> engineering notes with working code.

Also known as: Vevaar, iamvevaar, वेवार.

## Who he is

- **Current role:** Full Stack Engineer at AstroSure (Chennai, since June 2024).
  Built revenue-generating microsites and the Agastya chatbot, which serves
  2,500+ daily active users. Work spans payments (Razorpay), rate limiting,
  influencer onboarding, and CI/CD.
- **Self-described title:** Creative Software Engineer — design in one hand,
  code in the other.
- **Previously:** Jr. Software Developer at Value At Void (Dubai, HireHive);
  Frontend Intern at Flooid (Bengaluru, HerKey React to Next.js migration).
- **Works in:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, design
  engineering, developer experience, technical writing.

## Products

- [FFmcpeg](https://ffmcpeg.vevaar.com/): A GUI-based MCP for FFmpeg. All of
  FFmpeg's power for video work, without writing a single command. Source at
  [github.com/iamvevaar/FFmcpeg](https://github.com/iamvevaar/FFmcpeg), and a
  [demo](https://youtu.be/Be9bmZHEjhw).
- [Life at GITS](https://lifeatgits.vevaar.com/): An interactive infinite canvas
  of life at GITS. Pan, zoom, and fly through it.
- [CampusAI](https://campusai.vevaar.com/): Currently building. An AI senior that
  knows your university, your syllabus, and your deadlines.
- [X-Fathom](https://x-fathom.vevaar.com/): Chrome extension for an enhanced,
  immersive Fathom experience. Live on the
  [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/x-fathom/ephnakeihcedogcajbfodoenjhangmhg).

## Writing

Build-in-public engineering notes. Each post ships with a plain-markdown
companion for agents and LLMs.

- [Blog index](https://www.vevaar.com/blog)
- [Putting Claude Code under a self-hosted SigNoz microscope](https://www.vevaar.com/blog/claude-code-signoz-dashboard):
  Claude Code emits OpenTelemetry; point it at a local SigNoz container for a
  private dashboard of every token, tool call, and quota tick.
- [The free contact form backend hiding in your Google account](https://www.vevaar.com/blog/free-contact-form-google-sheets)
- [Skyvern, the AI browser agent](https://www.vevaar.com/blog/skyvern-ai-browser-agent)
- [Scaffolding an MDX blog](https://www.vevaar.com/blog/scaffolding-mdx-blog)
